environment: local modified product source; no signed-device or provider exercise in this documentation pass
scopeNote: Rows group one user-visible native capability and its coupled adapters. A dependency, button or mock test is not certification.

capabilities.operation: Discover and purchase a driver or rental subscription; Restore and reconcile
capabilities.app: consumer; System Admin investigates but does not launch a purchase
capabilities.ios: StoreKit 2 through in_app_purchase_storekit; transaction updates and unfinished transactions
capabilities.callback: typed product/purchase observation enters a scoped journal; some UI event strings still require exact-operation correlation
capabilities.api: store-billing products, quote, verify, restore and operation status; signed JWS and App Store Server evidence govern entitlement
capabilities.scope: bundle, environment, account token, user, tenant, country, product, term, operation and transaction family
capabilities.permission: App Store signing, product availability, agreement and sandbox/tester context
capabilities.journal: protected account/product/operation checkout and transaction evidence
capabilities.recovery: Restore is non-charging; unresolved new checkout stays fenced until exact provider/server evidence or manual review
capabilities.diagnostic: sanitized product-discovery and operation support reference; current storefront detail remains an instrumentation gap
capabilities.status: implemented source; current signed-iPhone six-product and lifecycle certification untested

capabilities.operation: Discover, purchase, replace, acknowledge and restore a Play subscription
capabilities.app: consumer; System Admin investigates but does not launch a purchase
capabilities.android: in_app_purchase_android over Play Billing; Play-installed signing and licensed tester context
capabilities.callback: product/base-plan/offer and purchase updates enter account-scoped operation recovery
capabilities.api: store-billing products, quote, prepare, verify, restore and operation status; subscriptionsv2.get is provider evidence; RTDN only invalidates
capabilities.scope: package, account, tenant, country, product, base plan, offer, operation and purchase-token family
capabilities.permission: Play distribution and billing configuration; authenticated RTDN subscription
capabilities.journal: protected prepared purchase and token-hash operation evidence
capabilities.recovery: pending and response-loss states retain the first operation; exact provider order/owner proof precedes entitlement
capabilities.diagnostic: sanitized product, offer and operation category with support reference; no raw token
capabilities.status: implemented source; current signed-Play lifecycle certification not established by this pass

capabilities.operation: Register push token; receive, present and open an alert
capabilities.app: consumer and System Admin use separate app identities and recipient streams
capabilities.ios: APNs registration and OS notification presentation through Firebase Messaging
capabilities.android: FCM registration, Android notification permission and channels
capabilities.callback: foreground/background/open event is a hint; tap rechecks current session and target permission
capabilities.api: notifications push-token and preferences; outbox, FirebasePushProvider and token-binding authority
capabilities.scope: app identity, account, tenant, country, installation, token generation and category preference
capabilities.permission: OS notification permission; configured APNs/FCM native identity
capabilities.journal: device notification preferences and server installation-token binding
capabilities.recovery: rotation or logout deactivates old binding; invalid-token cleanup and inbox/read-back do not imply delivery
capabilities.diagnostic: provider acceptance, token eligibility and OS presentation are separate sanitized stages
capabilities.status: implemented source; current signed APNs/FCM foreground/background/terminated delivery untested

capabilities.operation: Choose category-specific audible and vibration presentation
capabilities.app: consumer; restricted Admin notification policy differs
capabilities.ios: OS sound and haptic policy through iOS notification presentation
capabilities.android: user-owned notification channels and native sound MethodChannel
capabilities.callback: local foreground attention receipt is deduplicated; background behavior is OS-owned
capabilities.api: notification template/category and per-installation channel capability policy
capabilities.scope: installation, account, category, quiet preference and event identity
capabilities.permission: notification permission, channel settings, Focus/Do Not Disturb and device volume
capabilities.journal: device preference and bounded local presentation dedupe
capabilities.recovery: do not replay sound merely because a status read or notification tap occurs
capabilities.diagnostic: separate provider-accepted, device-received, displayed, sounded and vibrated observations
capabilities.status: implemented source; actual sound/vibration under Focus, Doze and killed states untested for current signed artifacts

capabilities.operation: Ring, answer, decline, end and recover a trip call
capabilities.app: consumer; System Admin has restricted call-evidence reads, not participant calling
capabilities.ios: CallKit through flutter_callkit_incoming and LiveKit/WebRTC audio
capabilities.android: Android calling UI through flutter_callkit_incoming and LiveKit/WebRTC audio
capabilities.callback: push/realtime ring and call-ended events reconcile against server call state
capabilities.api: voice call, call/end, token and call-status recovery; trip participants and server call session govern access
capabilities.scope: account, tenant, country, trip, call/session, participant role, event and expiry
capabilities.permission: microphone, audio focus, calling notification capability and provider configuration
capabilities.journal: scoped active-ring binding and terminal tombstone for interrupted teardown
capabilities.recovery: orphan ring sweep and server status read avoid one-sided endless ringing; OS delivery is not guaranteed
capabilities.diagnostic: sanitized call state, provider/realtime event and support reference; no audio content
capabilities.status: implemented source; current signed-device killed-state, phone interruption and media certification untested

capabilities.operation: Merge trip, chat and call hints after reconnect
capabilities.app: consumer; Admin has separate scoped live/operational reads
capabilities.ios: network and app lifecycle constrain SignalR socket continuity
capabilities.android: network and app lifecycle constrain SignalR socket continuity
capabilities.callback: versioned realtime event invalidates or advances projection; checkpoint read repairs gaps
capabilities.api: SignalR hub and country-cell authoritative entity state
capabilities.scope: account, tenant, country, role, trip and entity revision
capabilities.permission: authenticated session and permitted trip/room membership
capabilities.journal: last-good projection/checkpoint rather than socket state as authority
capabilities.recovery: reconnect and bounded read-back; duplicate or stale event cannot regress durable state
capabilities.diagnostic: connection generation and sanitized entity revision
capabilities.status: implemented source; multi-node and current signed background failover untested

capabilities.operation: Provide app-integrity evidence for protected requests and first install
capabilities.app: consumer and System Admin with distinct native application identities
capabilities.ios: Firebase App Check with App Attest capability/provisioning
capabilities.android: Firebase App Check with Play Integrity provider
capabilities.callback: time-bounded proof acquisition has typed availability and cancellation, not a role grant
capabilities.api: AppCheckProtection and device-admission middleware verify provider proof and installation/session independently
capabilities.scope: native app ID, signed artifact, installation, session, account and request
capabilities.permission: App Attest entitlement, Firebase registration, Play signing/API configuration
capabilities.journal: no reusable authorization inferred from an old proof; installation credential is separate
capabilities.recovery: transient bootstrap failures retry within bounds without a misleading ban; known ban/revocation fails closed
capabilities.diagnostic: sanitized provider category, support code and correlation; no attestation token
capabilities.status: implemented source; exact signed-artifact first-install iOS/Android certification not established

capabilities.operation: Enroll, rotate, restrict and revoke a particular app installation
capabilities.app: consumer and System Admin maintain separate secure-storage namespaces
capabilities.ios: Keychain-backed installation secret and reinstall marker
capabilities.android: Keystore-backed installation secret and app-data marker
capabilities.callback: device admission returns allowed, checking, restricted or revoked state
capabilities.api: Devices controller and DeviceAccessMiddleware; control DB binds installation and session family
capabilities.scope: app, installation, account, session family and token version
capabilities.permission: signed application identity and server-issued credential
capabilities.journal: installation secret/verifier and account-scoped device state
capabilities.recovery: reinstall may create a new installation; descriptive make/model/IP is not stable identity
capabilities.diagnostic: bounded admission outcome and support reference; never raw secret or hardware ID
capabilities.status: implemented source; current two-app reinstall/ban signed-device matrix untested

capabilities.operation: Read/write scoped protected state and locally unlock visible content
capabilities.app: consumer; Admin uses independent protected session store
capabilities.android: Keystore-backed secure storage and BiometricPrompt through local_auth
capabilities.callback: typed success, cancel, lockout or unavailable result; late callback is generation-scoped
capabilities.api: identity/session API owns access and recent-auth/2FA proof; local unlock is not financial authorization
capabilities.scope: app, account, tenant, country, role, installation and record key
capabilities.permission: OS biometric enrollment and protected storage availability
capabilities.journal: scoped session credentials, command journals and local lock preference
capabilities.recovery: corrupt/missing protected record blocks unsafe replay and offers account-safe reauthentication
capabilities.diagnostic: availability, certainty and support reference without stored value
capabilities.status: implemented source; signed Keychain/Keystore process-death and reinstall matrix untested

capabilities.operation: Receive Apple, Google or Facebook identity and complete an account-link ceremony
capabilities.ios: Sign in with Apple plus Google/Facebook native SDK callbacks
capabilities.android: Google/Facebook native SDK callbacks; Apple flow only where supported
capabilities.callback: provider success, explicit cancel and failure remain distinct; ceremony generation fences late results
capabilities.api: auth/social and protected pending-link/recent-auth endpoints own account binding
capabilities.scope: provider subject, pending ceremony, account, app and registration intent
capabilities.permission: provider app registration, associated URL schemes and signed native configuration
capabilities.journal: short-lived pending-link intent and Apple name capture where provider exposes it
capabilities.recovery: email equality never auto-links identities; account switch cancels stale ceremony
capabilities.diagnostic: sanitized provider/cancellation category; never identity token
capabilities.status: implemented source; current signed-provider callback matrix untested

capabilities.operation: Acquire a bounded current rider or driver position
capabilities.ios: Core Location via geolocator, including reduced accuracy
capabilities.android: Fused location via geolocator, including approximate permission
capabilities.callback: fix carries timestamp, accuracy and source; no fix, stale fix and upload failure are separate
capabilities.api: Maps/location routes and trip telemetry reject invalid coordinates and unauthorized trip scope
capabilities.scope: account, country, active request or trip, permission and fix timestamp
capabilities.permission: foreground location permission and enabled location services
capabilities.journal: last-good display location is not current GPS or transition authority
capabilities.recovery: cancel superseded acquisition; classify timeout, GPS off, approximate or stale/future signal
capabilities.diagnostic: failure kind and accuracy bucket without coordinates
capabilities.status: implemented source; current signed GPS-off/approximate/device route exercise untested

capabilities.operation: Run bounded active-trip or managed-queue telemetry while screen is off
capabilities.ios: ActiveTripLocationManager.swift with Core Location background mode
capabilities.android: ActiveTripLocationService.kt foreground service with visible notification
capabilities.callback: native fix/permission/service lifecycle returns to Dart and scoped upload
capabilities.api: trip and queue session/expiry controls own allowed tracking window
capabilities.scope: driver, tenant, country, trip or queue lease, purpose and expiry
capabilities.permission: background location entitlement/permission, foreground-service type and OS policy
capabilities.journal: short server-authorized telemetry lease; no general tracking authorization
capabilities.recovery: stop on terminal trip, lease expiry, logout or denial; reconcile gap without inventing position
capabilities.diagnostic: acquisition versus upload failure, expiry and safe freshness metadata
capabilities.status: implemented source; screen-off signed-device and route-deviation delivery untested

capabilities.operation: Render, gesture and frame route/markers in trip and ride maps
capabilities.ios: Google Maps iOS SDK through google_maps_flutter
capabilities.android: Google Maps Android SDK through google_maps_flutter
capabilities.callback: map camera, gesture and marker observations are presentation-only
capabilities.api: server Maps proxy and fare/route authority; map tiles do not validate price
capabilities.scope: app signing identity, map key restriction, country, selected route and trip
capabilities.permission: Maps SDK registration and exact package/bundle plus signing-certificate restriction
capabilities.journal: optional last-good route drawing, not transactional route truth
capabilities.recovery: blank/unauthorized map requires key restriction diagnosis and safe route text fallback
capabilities.diagnostic: SDK authorization category and render status without full route in public log
capabilities.status: implemented source; exact current Play/App Store signed map gestures and authorization untested

capabilities.operation: Capture/select/crop a profile, identity or vehicle image/document
capabilities.app: consumer; Admin has separate restricted evidence preview/decision surface
capabilities.ios: Photos/camera/files presentation through picker, cropper and file_picker plugins
capabilities.callback: selected, cancelled, unavailable and failed are distinct; native resume keeps mounted route
capabilities.api: uploads and document metadata/finalization; scan and reviewer decisions are server-owned
capabilities.scope: account, tenant, country, document purpose, upload operation and revision
capabilities.permission: camera/media/files access limited to selected content and documented use
capabilities.journal: draft route/form and recoverable upload intent; local selection alone is not approved evidence
capabilities.recovery: preserve route through picker/cropper; retry upload using original operation after status check
capabilities.diagnostic: selection/crop/upload/scan stage without local path or document content
capabilities.status: implemented source; current signed cropper resume and document-review exercise untested

capabilities.operation: Finalize private upload or save a governed export
capabilities.app: consumer and System Admin according to role and document grant
capabilities.ios: private file provider and document-picker save target
capabilities.android: SAF/FilePicker save target and temporary private files
capabilities.callback: upload/save completion differs from OS picker cancellation and server scan acceptance
capabilities.api: upload metadata, scan and authorized download/export endpoints own retained evidence
capabilities.scope: account, tenant, country, object grant, upload revision and export purpose
capabilities.permission: user-selected file scope; private object grant and server authorization
capabilities.journal: prepared upload metadata and server object status; no public document URL
capabilities.recovery: scan timeout stays quarantined; missing/expired download grant requests a new authorized read
capabilities.diagnostic: bounded file type/size/stage; never document contents or presigned URL
capabilities.status: implemented source; current signed file-provider/save/download exercise untested

capabilities.operation: Handle app links, notification taps, PayPal return and external legal reader resume
capabilities.app: consumer; Admin has separate restricted link audience
capabilities.ios: universal links, custom URL callbacks and Flutter lifecycle
capabilities.android: verified App Links, intents and Flutter lifecycle
capabilities.callback: typed intent with account/workspace generation and validated target
capabilities.api: current auth/route target and payment-operation status own final navigation/outcome
capabilities.scope: app, account, tenant, country, role, route/entity and original operation
capabilities.permission: associated domains/assetlinks, signed app identity and current resource grant
capabilities.journal: pending validated intent and original payment key where a mutation is unresolved
capabilities.recovery: never repeat a payment or trip mutation from a callback; resolve status then navigate
capabilities.diagnostic: intent category, validation result and support reference without full return URL
capabilities.status: implemented source; current signed universal-link/PayPal return process-death test untested

capabilities.operation: Accept credential autofill while keeping social callback and account ceremony separate
capabilities.app: consumer and Admin have separate login forms; social signup belongs to consumer
capabilities.ios: iOS credential autofill and native Apple/Google/Facebook callback
capabilities.android: Android autofill/password manager and Google/Facebook callback
capabilities.callback: autofill supplies input only; server login/social ceremony establishes identity
capabilities.api: central identity login, social, pending-link and session endpoints
capabilities.scope: form, provider ceremony, app and account/session
capabilities.permission: associated domains/autofill metadata and social provider configuration
capabilities.journal: form draft or protected pending link, never plaintext password persistence by app
capabilities.recovery: paste/autofill cannot bypass recent-auth or 2FA; stale callback cannot bind another account
capabilities.diagnostic: sanitized input/provider failure without password or token
capabilities.status: implemented source; current signed password-manager and social callback matrix untested

capabilities.operation: Observe and request supported Play app update
capabilities.ios: not applicable; App Store release flow is independent
capabilities.callback: availability/completion response does not override server session or workflow state
capabilities.api: release catalogue/policy if consulted; store owns installed-version transition
capabilities.scope: package, signing identity, current build and update track
capabilities.permission: Play installation and eligible update track
capabilities.recovery: unavailable update leaves current app usable subject to server minimum-version policy
capabilities.diagnostic: update availability category without store account identity
capabilities.status: adapter implemented; current Play-track update exercise untested

capabilities.operation: Obscure sensitive on-screen content during restricted native transitions
capabilities.app: consumer and separately configured Admin app
capabilities.android: native screen protection MethodChannel and lifecycle policy
capabilities.callback: checking state obscures mounted Navigator without destroying pending picker result
capabilities.api: device admission and account revocation remain server authority
capabilities.scope: app, account, protected route and lifecycle generation
capabilities.permission: native window/screen capability and current device-policy state

capabilities.recovery: transient revalidation preserves route; authoritative ban performs terminal cleanup
